title: 勒奇山基線隧道~Lotschberg Base Tunnel
focus: 分期雙孔、混合交通容量與營運中擴建~Staged twin bores, mixed-traffic capacity and expansion beside operations
summary: 勒奇山案例的核心不是單純延長隧道，而是已營運路線如何面對分期建造留下的容量與介面限制。BLS公開資料將其描述為約35公里的基線隧道；本課把未裝設段、單線衝突、維修窗口、出水與施工隔離分開，逐步建立可供營運和擴建共同審查的證據鏈。~The Lotschberg case concerns the capacity and interfaces left by staged construction rather than length alone. BLS describes an approximately 35 km base tunnel. This course separates unfinished bore sections, single-track conflicts, maintenance windows, water conditions and construction isolation, building an evidence chain that operations and expansion teams can review together.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.52 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.52 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.anchor: 區段占用時間~Section occupation time
units.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量~Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity
units.mechanism: 以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。一段單線或共用道岔會把連續鐵路變成受時間窗限制的系統，清空時間與衝突進路和列車行走時間同樣重要。單方向理論容量只提供上界比較；雙向交會、延誤傳播及維修封鎖會改變可實現班次，必須在共同時距圖中檢查。~At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic. A single-track section or shared turnout creates time-window constraints, making clearance and conflicting routes as important as travel time. One-direction theoretical capacity gives only a comparison bound. Opposing movements, propagated delays and maintenance closures alter achievable service and must be examined together on a common timetable diagram.
units.model: 原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h。僅把區段占用增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.24324 trains/h。邊界：單方向理論容量，未含對向衝突、延誤或維修；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min. C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h. Increasing only occupation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.24324 trains/h. Boundary: One-direction theoretical capacity without opposing conflicts, delay or maintenance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。從列車通過與路線釋放時間戳重建占用，對照進路衝突表，再測試一班延誤如何影響後續交會而非只看平均準點。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Reconstruct occupation from passage and release timestamps, compare the route-conflict table and test how one delay affects subsequent meets. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。把清空時間省略或把雙向列車當同方向排列會高估容量，實際服務可能需要長時間等待才能保留安全間隔。~One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. Omitting clearance or treating opposing trains as one-direction traffic overstates capacity and requires long real waits to preserve separation.
units.misconception: 單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。~One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
units.practice: 本案「區段占用時間」的交付需回答：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。容量報告附衝突進路、列車性能和維修窗，任何新增班次須由營運方用可重播的時距圖驗證，不只比較單一每小時數字。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the section occupation time handover must address the following evidence: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Capacity reports include conflicting routes, train performance and maintenance windows; operations validates additions with replayable timetables rather than one hourly figure.

units.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求~Base-alignment grade and traction demand
units.mechanism: 比較基線路線的低坡度與列車質量，將坡度功率和站外加速需求分開，避免把省能全歸於隧道長度。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。~Compare low-gradient alignment and train mass, separating grade power from approach acceleration rather than attributing all energy benefit to tunnel length. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.26e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0054 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1334.94 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1468.44 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.26e+06 kg; grade=0.0054 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1334.94 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1468.44 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 下坡回生未計效率時可能被當作全部可回收能量。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。~Ignoring regenerative efficiency can overstate recoverable downhill energy. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.
units.misconception: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。~A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
units.practice: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 勒奇山擴建的教學模型保留營運孔排水與新開挖孔之間的水力連通，檢查新排水是否改變既有孔外壓。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Retain hydraulic connectivity between the operating bore and a hypothetical new heading, testing whether new drainage changes pressure around the existing bore. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為485.595 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 485.595 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=297 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為326.7 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=297 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 326.7 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 營運旁擴建需要共用入口時，列車、材料與維修人員各自占用時間，不能假設夜間窗口全供出渣。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~When expansion shares access with operations, trains, materials and maintainers each occupy time; a night window is not entirely available for spoil transport. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為143.377 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 143.377 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 忽略恢復檢查會使最後一車出渣與首班營運列車衝突。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Omitted restoration checks create conflict between the final spoil movement and first service. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：將保護設置和恢復營運時間從窗口中明確扣除。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Explicitly deduct protection setup and restoration time from each access window. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 擴建需接回既有軌道控制網，研究新舊坐標、溫度和軌道維修基準不一致所造成的累積偏差。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Expansion must reconnect with existing track control, so examine bias from differing coordinate revisions, temperatures and maintenance reference systems. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3360 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0423533 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0465887 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=3360 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0423533 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0465887 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以獨立控制線核對新舊網的尺度及高程轉換。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Independently verify scale and height transformations between old and new networks. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只比坐標數字而未比版本可能把基準移動當結構位移。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Comparing coordinates without revisions confuses datum change with structural movement. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以獨立控制線核對新舊網的尺度及高程轉換。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently verify scale and height transformations between old and new networks. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 以施工區與營運區隔離為題，分析門位及施工風管改變時兩區壓差，保留營運事故模式的獨立需求。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Study pressure differences across construction-operational isolation as doors and temporary ducts change, retaining the separate requirements of operational incident modes. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=620 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=31.8292 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為38.5134 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=620 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=31.8292 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 38.5134 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 施工排風若短路到營運區，兩側感測器可能各自顯示正常局部風速。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~A construction-air shortcut may coexist with apparently normal local velocities on both sides. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：在核准隔離狀態下比對施工側風量與營運側壓差。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare construction airflow and operational pressure under approved isolation states. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 分期工程的避難路徑可能穿越暫時封閉區域，建立依施工階段變動的路線圖，不能只保留最終完工配置。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Staged works can temporarily close an escape route; maintain stage-specific access maps rather than relying only on the final completed arrangement. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=86 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=536 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為581 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=86 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=536 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 581 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 走查每個施工階段的門位、可通行淨寬和資訊標示。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Walk each stage to check door state, usable width and signs. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 舊版逃生圖若仍指向施工封閉段，距離計算再精確也無效。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~An obsolete map leading into a closed works zone invalidates precise distance calculations. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：走查每個施工階段的門位、可通行淨寬和資訊標示。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Walk each stage to check door state, usable width and signs. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 擴建介面需把舊設備識別碼、控制位址與新竣工資料連結，檢查維修系統是否能辨認同名不同孔設備。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Link legacy identifiers and control addresses to expansion records, testing whether maintenance systems distinguish similarly named assets in different bores. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=103 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.466 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.9126 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=103 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.466 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.9126 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽樣由現場標籤追到圖紙、控制點及檢修紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample the trace from field label to drawing, control point and maintenance record. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 重複識別碼會把故障回報派到錯誤孔別，完整表格也可能內容錯配。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Duplicate identifiers send fault responses to the wrong bore despite apparently complete records. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽樣由現場標籤追到圖紙、控制點及檢修紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample the trace from field label to drawing, control point and maintenance record. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「單線瓶頸與時距容量」，再獨立計算「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」。原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h。僅把區段占用增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.24324 trains/h。邊界：單方向理論容量，未含對向衝突、延誤或維修；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為143.377 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity, then independently calculate shared access and transport bottlenecks. Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min. C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h. Increasing only occupation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.24324 trains/h. Boundary: One-direction theoretical capacity without opposing conflicts, delay or maintenance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 143.377 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2007 年公開記錄：勒奇山基線隧道投入營運，部分第二孔仍待擴充。勒奇山案例的核心不是單純延長隧道，而是已營運路線如何面對分期建造留下的容量與介面限制。BLS公開資料將其描述為約35公里的基線隧道；本課把未裝設段、單線衝突、維修窗口、出水與施工隔離分開，逐步建立可供營運和擴建共同審查的證據鏈。本課把「分期雙孔、混合交通容量與營運中擴建」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2007: Lotschberg Base Tunnel enters service with portions of the second bore awaiting expansion. The Lotschberg case concerns the capacity and interfaces left by staged construction rather than length alone. BLS describes an approximately 35 km base tunnel. This course separates unfinished bore sections, single-track conflicts, maintenance windows, water conditions and construction isolation, building an evidence chain that operations and expansion teams can review together. The course treats staged twin bores, mixed-traffic capacity and expansion beside operations as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 approximately 35 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about approximately 35 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2007 年事件：勒奇山基線隧道投入營運，部分第二孔仍待擴充。~2007 event: Lotschberg Base Tunnel enters service with portions of the second bore awaiting expansion.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=13.2 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=13.2 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=13.2 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 13.2 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「區段占用時間」：區段占用=15 min，其餘輸入依單元，結果=3.52941 trains/h；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching section occupation time: occupation=15 min, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 3.52941 trains/h; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「支護安裝時點」：局部剛度=33 kN/mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=297 kN；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching support activation time: local stiffness=33 kN/mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 297 kN; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「出渣運輸節拍」：車輛數=4 個，其餘輸入依單元，結果=157.714 t/h；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching muck-transport cycle: vehicles=4 count, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 157.714 t/h; not measured or accepted project data.
